Name: After Rain Moisture
Author: DeyvidMods
Description:
[heading]AFTER RAIN MOISTURE[/heading]
Have you ever spent an entire day watching it rain, gone to bed at 2 AM, and then woken up at 6 AM to find that all your tilled soil is already dry again?
[b]After Rain Moisture[/b] makes rain feel a little more natural and useful.
When it rains in a location, the tilled soil in that location will remain watered for [b]one additional day[/b].
HOW IT WORKS
The rule is simple:
[b]Rain today → watered soil tomorrow.[/b]
For example:
[list]
[*]Monday: It rains → the soil is watered normally.[/*]
[*]Tuesday: Sunny → the soil remains watered because it rained on Monday.[/*]
[*]Wednesday: If Tuesday was dry, the soil returns to normal and needs watering again.[/*]
[/list]If it rains again on Tuesday, the effect is renewed:
[list]
[*]Monday: Rain.[/*]
[*]Tuesday: Rain → Monday's moisture is still present and the new rain renews the effect.[/*]
[*]Wednesday: The soil remains watered.[/*]
[*]Thursday: If Wednesday was dry, normal watering is required again.[/*]
[/list]The effect never accumulates indefinitely. [b]Each rainy day provides exactly one additional day of moisture.[/b]
LOCATION-BASED WEATHER
After Rain Moisture tracks rain [b]separately for each outdoor location[/b].
If it rains on your main farm but not on Ginger Island, only the farm that actually received rain will keep its soil watered the following day.
This also makes the system better suited for modded locations and maps that may use different weather conditions.
WHAT THE MOD DOES NOT CHANGE
After Rain Moisture only extends the moisture left by rain for one additional day.
It does [b]not[/b]:
[list]
[*]Speed up crop growth.[/*]
[*]Change fertilizers.[/*]
[*]Change sprinklers.[/*]
[*]Modify seasons or weather.[/*]
[*]Prevent tilled soil from disappearing normally.[/*]
[*]Keep soil watered permanently.[/*]
[*]Require a profession, skill, book, talent, or progression system.[/*]
[/list]──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

The effect is [b]always active[/b] while the mod is installed.
WHY?
The goal is simple: [b]Quality of Life with a little extra immersion.[/b]
Rain already saves you from watering for one day. After Rain Moisture simply makes the ground behave as though that rain didn't completely disappear the moment you went to sleep.
You still need to water your crops normally during dry periods — but after a rainy day, you get [b]one extra day off from watering[/b].
REQUIREMENTS
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[/list]No Content Patcher, professions, skills, or other gameplay mods are required.
INSTALLATION
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download After Rain Moisture.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]AfterRainMoisture[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]That's it.
[b]Let the rain do a little more work for you. 🌧️🌱[/b]
